subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: Waze: Drivers Helping Drivers
description: A short lesson to help you apply Waze: Drivers Helping Drivers.

hook.text: What if every driver reported traffic, police, and hazards in real time?

buildup.text: Waze crowdsources traffic data from millions of drivers to find the fastest routes.

discovery.text: Community reports about accidents, speed traps, and road closures update in real time.

twist.text: Google bought Waze for $1.1 billion and uses its data to improve Google Maps traffic.

climax.text: Waze proved that collective intelligence from users can beat any proprietary data source.

punchline.text: Millions of drivers became a traffic sensor network.

quiz.question: How does Waze gather traffic information?
